items.title: GoDaddy (GDDY) Stock Is Up, What You Need To Know
items.summary: Shares of domain registrar and web services company GoDaddy (NYSE:GDDY) jumped 3% in the afternoon session after the Financial Times reported, citing people familiar with the matter, that Gen Digital, maker of Norton 360 antivirus software, made an early-stage takeover offer for the web domain provider.
